title: Pullback compatibility of the quasi-coherent external cup product
statement: Let k be a field [def-weil-field], X and Y schemes over k [def-pc-scheme], quasi-compact with affine diagonals, and F and G quasi-coherent modules [pqf-def-coherent]. Let X' and Y' be arbitrary schemes over k with k-morphisms u:X'->X and v:Y'->Y, and let w:X' x_k Y' -> X x_k Y commute with the two projections [def-pc-fibre-product]. For all p,q in N and a in H^p(X,F), b in H^q(Y,G), pullback along w of the external cup product a cup b equals the external cup product u^*a cup v^*b, after the canonical composition and tensor-pullback coefficient isomorphism [def-pc-module-pullback], [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations]. This asserts compatibility of the canonical operation only; it asserts no Kunneth equivalence.

source.place: Varieties, Lemma varieties-lemma-kunneth (the Kunneth lemma used in Tag 0BED)

proof.text: Functoriality. Let u:X'\to X and v:Y'\to Y be morphisms of schemes over k and w = u x_k v : X' x_k Y' \to X x_k Y, so that pr_1 o w = u o pr_1' and pr_2 o w = v o pr_2' (def-pc-fibre-product); identify w^*(pr_1^*F tensor pr_2^*G) with pr_1'^*u^*F tensor pr_2'^*v^*G by lem-pc-module-pullback-identity-composition and lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-tensor. The claim is w^*(pr_1^*a cup pr_2^*b) = pr_1'^*u^*a cup pr_2'^*v^*b for a in H^p(X,F), b in H^q(Y,G). With U, V, W as in Step 1, a = c_U(alpha) and b = c_V(beta) for Cech cocycles alpha, beta (lem-sc-cech-comparison-map-iso-affine). Use the covers u^{-1}U, v^{-1}V and W' = w^{-1}W, which refines pr_1'^{-1}u^{-1}U and pr_2'^{-1}v^{-1}V by (i,j) \mapsto i, j since w^{-1}(U_i x V_j) is contained in w^{-1}pr_1^{-1}U_i = pr_1'^{-1}u^{-1}U_i. By lem-sc-picard-cech-cup-pullback-compat (a), each pullback in the claim is computed by the refinement cochain map, whose components are pullbacks of sections; by lem-pc-module-pullback-identity-composition the cochains obtained from alpha along w after pr_1 and along pr_1' after u coincide (both are pullback of the components along pr_1 o w = u o pr_1'), and likewise for beta. By lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-tensor (w^*(s tensor t) = w^*s tensor w^*t) the refinement cochain map along w sends the signed Cech cup product of two cochains to the cup product of their images. By lem-sc-picard-cech-cup-pullback-compat (b) the Cech cup products induce the sheaf cup products on X x_k Y and on X' x_k Y'. Hence both sides of the claim are c_{W'} of the same cochain, which proves the functoriality clause. The scalar Ext comparison transports the normalized sectionwise pullback unit and tensor coefficient map to scalarCohomologyPullback and scalarCohomologyCup; evaluate on injective-resolution representatives to identify these operations with the Cech formulas. No Cech comparison isomorphism is needed on the arbitrary schemes X' or Y': the pullback comparison square for the inverse-image covers suffices.

lean.statement: theorem picard_kunneth_functoriality (k : Type w) [Field k] (X Y : Scheme.{w}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) [CompactSpace X] [CompactSpace Y] [IsAffineHom (Limits.pullback.diagonal f)] [IsAffineHom (Limits.pullback.diagonal g)] (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [G.IsQuasicoherent] : ∀ (X' Y' : Scheme.{w}) (f' : X' ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g' : Y' ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (u : X' ⟶ X) (v : Y' ⟶ Y) (hu : u ≫ f = f') (hv : v ≫ g = g') (w : Limits.pullback f' g' ⟶ Limits.pullback f g) (h₁ : w ≫ Limits.pullback.fst f g = Limits.pullback.fst f' g' ≫ u) (h₂ : w ≫ Limits.pullback.snd f g = Limits.pullback.snd f' g' ≫ v) (p q : ℕ) (a : scalarCohomology f F p) (b : scalarCohomology g G q), scalarCohomologyMap (Limits.pullback.fst f' g' ≫ f') (externalCupPullbackIso f g f' g' u v w h₁ h₂ F G).hom (p + q) (scalarCohomologyPullback (Limits.pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (Limits.pullback.fst f' g' ≫ f') w (by rw [← Category.assoc, h₁, Category.assoc, hu]) (externalCupCoefficients f g F G) (p + q) (externalCup f g F G p q a b)) = externalCup f' g' ((tensorPullback u).obj F) ((tensorPullback v).obj G) p q (scalarCohomologyPullback f f' u hu F p a) (scalarCohomologyPullback g g' v hv G q b)
